description: This file is a shell script used for testing git fetch operations via a proxy, including setup of remote repositories, proxy scripts, and validation of fetch functionality.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, setting up a description and commands to execute.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with specified content, used here to generate proxy scripts.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
